name: Spanking Children
overview: Scripture teaches that loving discipline is essential in raising children, as a father’s care reflects God’s compassion for those who fear Him (Psalms 103:13). The wise child accepts instruction and correction, while neglecting discipline leads to folly and ruin (Proverbs 13:1; 19:18). The rod of correction is a biblical symbol of timely chastening that drives foolishness away and demonstrates love (Proverbs 13:24; 22:15). Training a child in the right way ensures lasting faithfulness and obedience throughout life (Proverbs 22:6).
